name: Gotenberg 9 PDF Conversion API
description: HTML, URL, Markdown and Office to PDF API with basic auth enabled.

upstream.gotenberg: gotenberg/gotenberg 9.10.0 (released 2026-11-24, latest stable; fixes the GHSA advisories of 2026-11-22 that affect 9.9.1), image gotenberg/gotenberg:9.10.0@sha256:2ce6fcd3f5019c82b0376065b9103d6d4938d34c1c06a39a8263a9fcf47a6f5b

PORT.description: HTTP port Gotenberg listens on (public domain target and healthcheck).

API_ENABLE_BASIC_AUTH.description: Require HTTP basic auth on every route except /health. Can only be turned off while the service has no public domain.

GOTENBERG_API_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Basic-auth password, generated at deploy. 16-256 characters without spaces; anything else locks the API until fixed.

API_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit per conversion request, e.g. 90s or 3m (upstream default 30s).

API_BODY_LIMIT.description: Optional. Maximum upload size per request, e.g. 100MB. Empty = no limit.

CHROMIUM_AUTO_START.description: Start Chromium at boot so the first HTML/URL conversion is fast. false starts it on first use (less idle RAM).

LIBREOFFICE_AUTO_START.description: Start LibreOffice at boot so the first Office conversion is fast. false starts it on first use (less idle RAM).

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: error, warn, info or debug.
